description: Cohort retention analysis + LTV — Cohort retention table from active counts per period: cohorts=Jan:1000,620,480,410;Feb:900,570,450;... (period 0 = cohort size, oldest first, up to 60 cohorts x 120 periods). Returns the retention matrix (%), size-weighted average curve, period-over-period churn, power-law or exponential fit (best R2), projected curve to periods= (default 24, max 120), expected active periods, newest-vs-oldest period-1 trend (IMPROVING/STABLE/WORSENING), and a curve verdict (FLATTENING/SLOWLY_FLATTENING/STEADY_DECAY/STEEP_DECAY/SMILE). Optional arpu= (revenue per active user per period), margin= % and discount= % per period give a projected LTV. Offline, instant. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_cohort_retention
